## Summary

Describe the user-facing and maintainer-facing impact of this change.

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `npm test`
- [ ] I updated docs when behavior or commands changed
- [ ] I added or updated tests where practical
- [ ] I checked for security or backwards-compatibility implications
- [ ] I added a changelog entry under `Unreleased` when needed

## Notes for reviewers

Call out risk areas, rollout considerations, and anything you want reviewed carefully.
